comment: Read at commit d55cb70, the head of the repository; 80422ac is the commit that set plugin.json to the installed 2.0.0 and the only change after it is bf6f969, a round to roundf in CM-9 that the merge d55cb70 brought in. The maker's manual, CM-manual-v0.6.5.pdf in the repository, states the bpm voltage standard as 1V per 50 bpm; CM_BpmClock::cvtobpm at CatroModulo.hpp:642 multiplies by 60, so a volt is 60 bpm, and every module in the plugin uses that function. The pulse width input is scaled knob*(1+V)*0.05, which is almost certainly a slip for knob*(1+V*0.05) or similar: a patched cable at 0V cuts the pulse width to a twentieth of the knob and unity needs 19V. The shape, rate, pulse width and phase inputs all replace rather than add to their knobs when a cable is present, and the shape, pulse width and select-style inputs multiply the knob, so a patched cable at 0V zeroes the control. Nothing in this plugin is polyphonic: the source has no setChannels, getPolyVoltage or getChannels anywhere. The plugin adds no context menu items of any kind.
